description.en: His rolling piano crushes plants while his music causes dancing zombies to switch lanes.
description.zh: 行进的钢琴会碾压植物，弹奏的音乐让跳舞的僵尸在行间穿梭。

chat.en: Pianist Zombie only knows two songs, and they're both groaners.
chat.zh: 奏琴僵尸只知道两首曲子，而且歌词都是吼叫。

text.en: causes cowboy zombies to switch lanes
text.zh: 使牛仔僵尸们开始舞蹈换行
